newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks end firm on buying of telecoms, miners.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks end firm on buying of telecoms, miners.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed firm on Wednesday, led buy stocks in the telecommunications and mining sectors, which investors believed would see healthy growth this year, brokers said

The General Index .IGRA climbed 0.80 percent to 1,556.7 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index .ISEL rose 0.59 percent to 2,236.5 points. In 1,766 trades, volume was 51.6 million soles ($19.6 million), brokers said.
"The market is edging up gradually after a series of corrections (in early February), because growth prospects are solid," Pablo Navarro of local brokerage Fortuna said.

Among leaders, benchmark Telefonica climbed 0.69 percent, closing at 5.86 soles in 16 percent of the session's total volume. Polymetal miner Buenaventura rose 2.56 percent to 20.00 soles in nine percent of the session's total volume.
